chunks: And in the narration of Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad, from al-ʿUbaydī, from Zakariyyā al-Muʾmin, who raised it, that he said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: “When a girl reaches six years of age, a boy should not kiss her, and a boy should not kiss a woman once he has passed seven years of age.”
ai.seo_question: At what age should boys and girls no longer be kissed affectionately according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives an age-based ruling concerning affectionate physical contact between children and the opposite sex. It reflects Islamic legal and ethical concern for modesty, boundaries, and proper upbringing from an early age.
